notes.title: Japan Train Models - JR East Edition Distribution start!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44696100/5e3ba95e104cb38627911d0495dbe9f160108ac7.jpg[/img]
"Japan Train Models" a game for enjoying trains, is now available on Steam!
The first game includes three representative cars of JR East.

Please look forward to future news on the newest additions to the series!
